message: Adds read-only Racing Legends on the Stats page: Arch-Rivals based on repeated same-race encounters; individual-car and manufacturer dynasty contenders using existing Evil R1 medal rules (3 golds to qualify); and verified multi-round Festival and Swiss-stage comeback Top Fives. Expandable phone-friendly record cards show the leader or Awaiting First Record. No changes to racing results, Evil R1 progress, existing records, medal awards, or Spaces. Take a Portable Backup before updating.
